generate_draft_release_notes: run the script to generate draft release notes in Markdown from GitHub PRs between two git tags
generate_final_release_notes: run the script to generate final release notes organized by language from labeled PRs
get_commit_log: get merge commit logs between two git tags or release branches using git log
get_pr_data: get PR metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by information
get_pr_titles: extract PR numbers from git logs and categorize them by release notes label and language
